description: Implementation of QuicIdleNetworkDetector class managing network idleness detection and timeouts in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: AlarmDelegate
classes.description: Internal delegate class for handling alarm callbacks within QuicIdleNetworkDetector.

methods.name: QuicIdleNetworkDetector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the idle network detector with parameters and creating an alarm.

methods.name: OnAlarm
methods.description: Handles alarm trigger events, checking and updating timeouts and invoking delegate callbacks.

methods.name: SetTimeouts
methods.description: Sets handshake and idle network timeouts, adjusts bandwidth update timeout if applicable.

methods.name: StopDetection
methods.description: Stops detection by canceling alarm and setting timeouts to infinite.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Updates state when a packet is sent, potentially adjusting alarm based on PTO delay.

methods.name: OnPacketReceived
methods.description: Updates last received packet time and resets alarm.

methods.name: SetAlarm
methods.description: Calculates and sets the next alarm deadline based on current timeouts.

methods.name: MaybeSetAlarmOnSentPacket
methods.description: Adjusts alarm to ensure connection remains alive for the next PTO.

methods.name: GetIdleNetworkDeadline
methods.description: Returns the deadline for idle network detection based on last activity and timeout.

methods.name: GetBandwidthUpdateDeadline
methods.description: Returns the deadline for bandwidth update based on last activity and timeout.
